name: Off-Hand Pound Dribble
setup: Athletic stance, knees bent, ball in the dribbling hand, eyes up.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.
Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.
Eyes up on a target on the wall, not on the ball.

faults.fix: Eyes up on a target on the wall; feel the ball, do not look at it.
Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.
Sit low in the stance: the lower you are, the shorter the ball trip.

name: Off-Hand In-and-Out Dribble
setup: Athletic stance, knees bent, ball in the dribbling hand, eyes up.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.

Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.

faults.fix: Eyes up on a target on the wall; feel the ball, do not look at it.

name: Off-Hand Hesitation Dribble
setup: Athletic stance, knees bent, ball in the dribbling hand, eyes up.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.
Slow the ball for a beat, eyes to the target, then explode past the cone.

name: Off-Hand Retreat Dribble
setup: Athletic stance, knees bent, ball in the dribbling hand, eyes up.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.
Two hard dribbles backward away from the cone, ball shielded, eyes up.

faults.fix: Eyes up on a target on the wall; feel the ball, do not look at it.
Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.
Sit low in the stance: the lower you are, the shorter the ball trip.

name: Off-Hand Cone Change-of-Pace Dribble
setup: Three cones down the floor, 5 metres apart.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.
Slow to each cone, then burst past it: slow, fast, slow, fast.
Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.

faults.fix: Eyes up on a target on the wall; feel the ball, do not look at it.
Pound the ball into the floor hard, below the knee.
Sit low in the stance: the lower you are, the shorter the ball trip.

name: Off-Hand Moving Hesitation
setup: Cones down the length of the floor; start at the baseline with the ball.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your weaker hand: slower and clean beats fast and sloppy.
Slow down to each cone, eyes to the target, then burst past it.
Push the ball out in front and run to it.

faults.fault: Dribbling at your feet while running
faults.fix: Push the ball out in front so you run onto it.
Cross the ball low below the knee at every cone.

name: Moving Crossover at Game Speed
setup: Cones down the length of the floor; start at the baseline with the ball.
cues: Full game speed now: if it gets sloppy, drop back to the slower version.
Push the ball out in front and run to it.
Eyes up on the far wall, not on the ball.

faults.fault: Dribbling at your feet while running
faults.fix: Push the ball out in front so you run onto it.
